prompt: Name an original member of the Fellowship of the Ring.
label: Getting Harder
source: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring, Book II chapter 3, 'The Ring Goes South'.
valueLogic: Frodo, Gandalf and Aragorn are named first by anyone who knows the story. Legolas, Gimli and Sam follow. Boromir is the first one people forget. Merry and Pippin are easy by nickname but genuinely hard by full name, which is why they carry the highest values and why both forms are accepted.
note: Merry and Pippin are accepted by nickname: the round shouldn't punish people who know the characters perfectly well. Bill the pony travelled with them but isn't one of the nine, so he's a non-busting distractor.

answers.name: Frodo Baggins
answers.fact: The Ring-bearer, and the reason the Fellowship exists at all.

answers.name: Gandalf
answers.fact: The Grey at the start, and the only member who does not finish the first book with the others.

answers.name: Aragorn
answers.fact: Known as Strider in Bree, and the heir to the throne of Gondor.

answers.name: Legolas
answers.fact: The only elf, and the son of the Elvenking of Mirkwood.

answers.name: Gimli
answers.fact: The only dwarf, and son of Gloin from The Hobbit.

answers.name: Samwise Gamgee
answers.fact: Frodo's gardener, and the only member who goes the whole way with him.

answers.name: Boromir
answers.fact: Son of the Steward of Gondor, and the only one of the nine who doesn't survive the quest.

answers.name: Peregrin Took
answers.fact: Pippin. The youngest of the nine, and included largely out of loyalty.

answers.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
answers.fact: Merry. The hardest of the nine to produce by his full name.

distractors.name: Bilbo Baggins
distractors.note: Offered to carry the Ring from Rivendell, but was far too old to go.

distractors.name: Elrond
distractors.note: Convened the council that formed the Fellowship, and did not join it.

distractors.name: Arwen
distractors.note: Not a member of the Fellowship in the book.

distractors.name: Galadriel
distractors.note: Hosted them in Lothlorien, but was never a member.

distractors.name: Tom Bombadil
distractors.note: Met before Rivendell, and never part of the quest.

distractors.name: Faramir
distractors.note: Boromir's brother, and met much later.

distractors.name: Gollum
distractors.note: Followed the Fellowship, but was certainly not in it.

distractors.name: Bill the pony
distractors.note: Carried their baggage from Bree, but is not one of the nine.

distractors.name: Thorin
distractors.note: From The Hobbit, and long dead by the time the Fellowship formed.
